name: Parapet Thrasher
clause: Whenever one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to an opponent, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn — • ~ deals 4 damage to each other opponent.

needs.proposedSignature: { op: 'damage'; amount: Amount; target: … | 'each-other-opponent' } — every opponent of the source's controller EXCEPT the player the current trigger was about (`item.triggeringPlayer`)
needs.semantics: '~ deals 4 damage to each other opponent' on a trigger about one opponent. The existing group word 'each-opponent' includes the player who was just dealt combat damage, which in a two-player game turns a mode that should do nothing into 4 damage to the only opponent.
needs.clause: • ~ deals 4 damage to each other opponent.

needs.proposedSignature: { on: 'combat-damage-player'; self?: boolean; filter?: Filter; batched?: true } — with `batched`, the event fires ONCE per combat-damage step per damaged player however many matching creatures dealt damage in it
needs.semantics: 'Whenever one or more Dragons you control deal combat damage to an opponent, …'. The engine queues one `combat-damage-player` trigger per damage assignment (game.ts:2493), so a filtered trigger fires once per creature; the printed card triggers once for the whole simultaneous batch (CR 510.2). Without it the modal choice is offered once per Dragon.
